bio: Why not indulge in Afternoon Tea at Bridgewood Manor? Situated in Chatham, this four-star hotel serves an array of traditional treats and boasts a spa - the perfect recipe for a relaxing afternoon!  Afternoon Tea is served in Squires Bar, a warm and welcoming space to enjoy an array of tea-time treats.  The Birdcage Afternoon Tea includes dainty finger sandwiches, scones with cream and jam and an array of delicious tea-time pastries. All served on a traditional Afternoon Tea stand.  Bridgewood Manor is situated in Kent, with the closest station is Chatham.
